items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; authentication and access boundaries, least privilege, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release approvals and provenance, dependency and supply-chain controls, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, complete TLS posture, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS coverage. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 35 pass, 14 fail, and 10 unknown, with open banner, consent, analytics, privacy, and terms findings. Retained worker and reviewer failures are containment signals, not evidence of compromise. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates, permit only bounded reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, data handling, provenance, and claims boundaries, and continue read-only security evidence work. Do not access credentials, private containers, permissions, dependencies, or production systems.

Continue the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated evidence, affected scope, owners, explicit unknowns, severity, and release implications for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness. Do not treat missing telemetry as a pass or zero; do not create duplicate telemetry requests or new production work.
